Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:10:1.hebrew: אם כן מצינו תורת שליחות לדבר עבירה - לומר שלוחו כמותו, וחייב השולח במעשה השליח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:10:1.english: If so, we have found the law of agency for a transgression - To say [that] one's agent is like himself, and the sender is liable for the agent's action.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:10:2.hebrew: וקי"ל - בקידושין בפ"ב (דף מב:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:10:2.english: And we maintain - In Kiddushin, in the second chapter (42b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:11:1.hebrew: בר חיובא הוא - שאף הוא מוזהר על הדבר, התם פטור השולח, דאמרינן ליה: דברי הרב ודברי התלמיד — דברי מי שומעין? ולא היה לו לעשות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:11:1.english: [The agent] is subject to liability - For he too is admonished regarding the matter; there, the sender is exempt, for we say to him: "[Between] the words of the Master and the words of the student, whose words do we listen to?" And he should not have done [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:12:1.hebrew: דלאו בני חיובא נינהו - לשלם, כדתנן: הם שחבלו באחרים פטורין (ב"ק פז.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:12:1.english: Since they are not subject to liability - [That is,] to pay, as we learned in a Mishnah: "They who injured others are exempt" (Bava Kamma 87a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:14:1.english: That if he wants, he performs - the agency.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:15:1.english: And betroth a divorced woman for me - And from the time of betrothal, [the priest] transgresses on account of "they shall not take."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:15:2.hebrew: אשה אינה באזהרת "לא תקיפו", לפי שאינה ב"בל תשחית פאת זקנך", כדאמר בקדושין (ד' לה:). והמקיף את הקטן חייב, שהמקיף באזהרה כניקף, דכתיב: "לא תקיפו" — אחד הניקף ואחד המקיף במשמע, במסכת [נזיר] (דף נז:). ו"קטן" דנקט — משום דסתמא גדול לא שביק לאקופי נפשיה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:15:2.english: A woman is not included in the prohibition of "You shall not round [the corners of your head]," because she is not [included] in "You shall not destroy the corner of your beard," as stated in Kiddushin (35b). And one who rounds [the head of] a minor is liable, for the one who rounds is under the prohibition just like the one whose head is rounded, as it is written: "You shall not round" — both the one whose head is rounded and the one who rounds are implied, [as taught] in tractate [Nazir] (57b). And [the reason the Gemara] specified "a minor" is because ordinarily an adult would not allow [someone] to round his [head].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:17:1.hebrew: תלמוד לומר ונתן מכל מקום - מדלא כתיב ובידה יתנהו, דרוש ונתן אוכתב לה ונתן. אלמא משום ידה אתרבאי, דאי משום שליחות, הא כבר כתיבא הכא, כדתניא (ושלח) [ושלחה] מלמד שהאשה עושה שליח, בקדושין בפרק ב' (דף מא.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:17:1.english: The verse states: "And he gives" in any case - Since it is not written "and in her hand he shall place it," expound "and he gives" [together with] "and he writes to her... and he gives." Thus, [her courtyard] is included because [it acts as] her hand; for if [it were included] because of agency, [agency] is already written here [in this verse], as it is taught [in a baraita]: "And he sends her — this teaches that a woman may appoint an agent," in Kiddushin, in the second chapter (41a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:1:1.hebrew: ה"ג כי תקון ליה רבנן בעלמא - כגון בסמטא שהוא רשות לכל אדם, או ברה"ר, או בצידי רשות הרבים, והיא הפקר לרבים, למשוך לתוכה הצריכין לצאת מן הדחק:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:1:1.english: This is the reading: "When the Sages instituted [it] for him in the world" - For example, in an alley [simta] that is open to every person, or in the public domain, or on the sides of the public domain, which is ownerless [and available] to the public for those who need to get out of the crowd to pull into it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:1:2.hebrew: לא תקון ליה רבנן - שהרי אין לאדם שם ד' אמות מיוחדות, שהרבה חברים יש לו בתוכה עומדים אצלו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:1:2.english: The Sages did not institute for him - For a person does not have four designated cubits there, since he has many companions inside [the field] standing next to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:7:1.hebrew: קטנה אין לה חצר - אם זרק לה בעלה גט תוך חצרה, לא קנתה לה חצרה להתגרש בו; וכן אם היתה עומדת ברה"ר וזרקו לה גט בארבע אמותיה. ואע"ג דגדולה מיגרשה, כדתנן (גיטין דף עח.), הזורק גט לאשתו בתוך ביתה כו', היתה עומדת ברה"ר וזרקו לה קרוב לה, מגורשת כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:7:1.english: A minor girl does not have a courtyard - If her husband threw a bill of divorce into her courtyard, her courtyard does not acquire [it] for her so that she becomes divorced thereby; and similarly, if she was standing in the public domain and they threw a bill of divorce into her four cubits, [she is not divorced]. Even though an adult woman is divorced [in such cases], as we learned in a Mishnah (Gittin 78a): "One who throws a bill of divorce to his wife inside her house, etc.; [if] she was standing in the public domain and he threw it close to her, she is divorced, etc."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:1.hebrew: משום ידה אתרבאי - דכתיב "ונתן בידה", ו"ידה" רשותה משמע, כדכתיב (במדבר כ״א:כ״ו) "ויקח את כל ארצו מידו":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:1.english: Due to her hand it was included - For it is written, "and he places [it] in her hand" [Deuteronomy 24:1], and "her hand" implies her domain, as it is written (Numbers 21:26), "and he took all his land from his hand."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:2.hebrew: כי היכי דאית לה יד - דמשיודעת לשמור את גיטה מגורשת, דלא מיעט רחמנא אלא שוטה, דמשלחה והיא חוזרת:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:2.english: Just as she has a hand - For once she knows how to guard her bill of divorce, she is divorced, as the Merciful One excluded only a mentally incompetent [woman], whom [her husband] sends away and she returns.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:3.hebrew: משום שליחות איתרבאי - מדרבי רחמנא שליחות לאדם — כדתניא (קידושין דף מא.): "ושלח" מלמד שהאיש עושה שליח, "ושלחה" מלמד שהאשה עושה שליח — אתרבאי נמי חצרה, דהויא לה כשלוחה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:3.english: It was included due to agency - Since the Merciful One included agency for a person — as it is taught [in a baraita] (Kiddushin 41a): "and he sends [her]" teaches that a man [can] appoint an agent, [and] "and he sends her" teaches that a woman [can] appoint an agent — her courtyard was also included, for it is like her agent.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:4.hebrew: וכי היכי דשליחות לית לה - דתנן שאין הקטן עושה שליח, דכי כתיב שליחות — בין בגיטין בין בפסח — "איש" כתיב בענין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:8:4.english: And just as she has no [power of] agency - For we learned [in a Mishnah] that a minor cannot appoint an agent, since when agency is written [in the Torah] — whether regarding bills of divorce or regarding the Paschal offering — "a man" is written in the passage.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:9:1.english: His hand - [From the verse:] “If it shall indeed be found in his hand” [Exodus 22:3].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:9:2.hebrew: גגו חצרו וקרפיפו מנין - שאם נכנסה שם ונעל בפניה לגונבה, שהוא חייב:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10b:9:2.english: His roof, his courtyard, and his enclosure, from where - That if [the stolen animal] entered there and he locked [the door] before it to steal it, he is liable.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:10:1.hebrew: ואי משום שליחות א"כ מצינו שליח לדבר עבירה - וא"ת: מה צריך להוכיח מכח דאין שליח כו'? אמאי לא מוכיח מדאתרבאי חצר מקרא דידו, כדבסמוך גבי גט מוכיח דחצר משום ידה איתרבאי מדאתרבאי מקרא דידה, ולא עביד שום הוכחה? וי"ל, דבסמוך מכח התנא מוכיח, דמרבה גגה וחצרה כידה להתגרש אפילו בעל כרחה או אפילו היא קטנה; ואי מטעם שליחות, לא היתה מתגרשת בעל כרחה ולא קטנה. אבל הכא אי אפשר להוכיח מכח זה, דאפילו בידו אינו קונה הגניבה בעל כרחו, ולא אם הוא קטן:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:10:1.english: And if [a courtyard acquires] due to agency, if so, we have found an agent for a transgression - And if you ask: Why does [the Gemara] need to prove [this] from the force of [the principle] that there is no agent [for a transgression], etc.? Why does it not prove [this] from [the fact] that a courtyard is included from the verse of "his hand," just as shortly below regarding a bill of divorce [the Gemara] proves that a courtyard is included by reason of "her hand" because it is included from the verse of "her hand," and does not make any [additional] proof? And one can answer that shortly below, [the Gemara] proves [it] from the force of the Tanna['s teaching], who includes her roof and her courtyard like her hand to be divorced even against her will or even when she is a minor; and if [it were] by reason of agency, she would not be divorced against her will, nor [if she were] a minor. Here, however, it is impossible to prove [it] from this [argument], for even with his [own] hand one does not acquire the stolen item against his will, nor if he is a minor.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:10:2.hebrew: אין שליח לדבר עבירה - בפ' האיש מקדש (קדושין דף מג.): איכא דיליף משחוטי חוץ, דכתיב "הוא" ולא שלוחו; ואיכא דיליף משום דהוה ליה מעילה וטביחה שני כתובים הבאים כאחד דיש שליח, ואין מלמדין:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:10:2.english: There is no agency for transgression - In the chapter HaIsh Mekadesh (Kiddushin 43a): There is one [opinion] that derives [this] from [the law of] slaughtering [sacrifices] outside [the Temple], as it is written: "he," and not his agent; and there is one [opinion] that derives [it] because [the laws of] misappropriation of consecrated property [me'ilah] and slaughtering [a stolen animal] are two scriptural verses that come as one [teaching] that there is agency, and [two verses that come as one] cannot teach [about other cases].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:13:1.hebrew: אשה ועבד בני חיובא נינהו - ואם תאמר, והתנן פרק הכונס (ב"ק דף נט:): "השולח את הבערה ביד חרש, שוטה וקטן — פטור", ואמאי? והא לאו בני חיובא נינהו! וי"ל דהתם משום דלאו בני שליחות נינהו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:13:1.english: A woman and a slave are subject to liability - And if you ask: But did we not learn in a mishnah in the chapter HaKones (Bava Kamma 59b): "One who sends a fire in the hand of a deaf-mute, an imbecile, or a minor is exempt"? And why [is the sender exempt], seeing that they are not subject to liability? And one can say that there [it is] because they are not capable of agency.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:14:1.hebrew: אי בעי לא עביד - וא"ת: והא דתנן (ב"ק דף עט. ושם) "היה מושכו ויוצא [ומת ברשות בעלים] — פטור, הגביהו [או הוציאו מרשות בעלים ומת] — חייב", ופרש"י בלשון אחד שאמר גנב לשומר: "שור אחד יש לי בבית פלוני, קחנו ותהא עליו שומר חנם"; הוציאו השומר מרשות בעלים ומת — חייב הגנב במשיכת השומר. ואמאי? והא אי בעי לא עביד! וי"ל: כיון שאין השומר יודע שהוא גנוב, הוה ליה כחצר דבעל כרחו מותיב ביה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:14:1.english: If he wants, he does not do [it] - And if you ask: Behold, we learned in a Mishnah (Bava Kamma 79a, and there): "[If] he was pulling it and going out [and it died in the owner's domain], he is exempt; [if] he lifted it [or took it out of the owner's domain and it died], he is liable." And Rashi explained in one interpretation that a thief said to a bailee: "I have a certain ox in So-and-so's house; take it and be an unpaid bailee for it." [If] the bailee took it out of the owner's domain and it died, the thief is liable through the bailee's pulling [of the ox]. But why? Behold, if he wants, he does not do [it]! And one can answer: Since the bailee does not know that it is stolen, he is like a courtyard where one places [an item] against its will.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:15:1.hebrew: דאמר לישראל קדש לי אשה גרושה - וא"ת: ואפי' אמר לכהן נמי? וי"ל: דכהן מקרי בר חיובא, הואיל ואם מקדשה לעצמו חייב; אבל ישראל, אע"ג דעובר משום "לפני עור לא תתן מכשול" כשמקדשה לכהן, כיון דאי מקדשה לעצמו לא מיחייב, לא מקרי בר חיובא. וא"ת: מאי נ"מ — בין למ"ד "אי בעי עביד" ובין למ"ד "שליח בר חיובא", לא לקי על הקדושין לרבא, דאמר בעשרה יוחסין (קדושין דף עח.): "קידש אינו לוקה, בעל לוקה"? וי"ל: דכי בעל אח"כ, לוקה אף על הקדושין, כדמוכח בריש תמורה (דף ה. ושם). א"נ י"ל: דאף לרבא נפקא מינה, דאי יש שליחות, חלין הקדושין, ואי אין שליחות, אין חלין הקדושין:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:15:1.english: Who said to an Israelite: Betroth a divorced woman for me - And if you ask: Even if he said [this] to a priest as well, [would there not also be a difference]? One can answer: A priest is called "subject to the obligation" [bar chiyuva], since if he betroths her for himself he is liable; however, an Israelite — even though he transgresses [the prohibition of] "Do not place a stumbling block before the blind" when he betroths her for a priest — since if he betroths her for himself he is not liable, he is not called "subject to the obligation." And if you ask: What is the practical difference — [for] both according to the one who says "if he wanted, he could do it" and according to the one who says "the agent must be subject to the obligation," he does not receive lashes for the betrothal according to Rava, who says in [chapter] Asarah Yuchasin (Kiddushin 78a): "If he betrothed [her], he does not receive lashes; if he cohabited [with her], he receives lashes"? One can answer: When he cohabits [with her] afterward, he receives lashes for the betrothal as well, as is evident at the beginning of Temurah (5a, and ad loc.). Alternatively, one can answer: Even according to Rava there is a practical difference, for if there is agency, the betrothal takes effect, and if there is no agency, the betrothal does not take effect:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:15:2.hebrew: אקפי לי קטן - וה"ה דהוה מצי למימר: "אקפי לי גדול", אלא שהגדול לא יניח עצמו להקיף, כדאמר פרק אלו הן הלוקין (מכות דף כ:) דאחד הניקף ואחד המקיף חייב. ואע"ג דמוקי לה התם כי ניקף מסייע ליה בהדיה — היינו משום דבענין אחר לא לקי, דהוה לאו שאין בו מעשה, אבל הלאו עובר לעולם [ועיין תוס' שבועות ג. ד"ה ועל הזקן, ותוספות נזיר נז: ד"ה ורב אדא]:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:15:2.english: Round [the corners of the head of] a minor for me - And the same applies that [the Gemara] could have said: "Round [the corners of the head of] an adult for me," except that an adult would not allow himself to be rounded, as it says in the chapter [entitled] Eilu Hen HaLokin (Makkot 20b), that both the one whose head is rounded and the one who rounds are liable. And even though [the Gemara] establishes it there [as referring to a case] where the one whose head is rounded assists him with it — that is because otherwise he does not receive lashes, since it is a negative commandment that does not involve an action; however, he always transgresses the negative commandment. [And see Tosafot on Shevuot 3a, s.v. Ve'al ha-zakan, and Tosafot on Nazir 57b, s.v. Ve-Rav Adda.]

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:7:1.hebrew: רבי יוחנן אמר יש לה ד' אמות - תימה, דלקמן מסיק משום דיליף מציאה מגט, אלמא שייך קנין ד' אמות בגט; ובפרק הזורק (גיטין דף עח: ושם ד"ה ר"י) קאמר ר"י: "קרוב לה" אפילו מאה אמה, ויכולה לשמרו הוי גט. וי"ל דבד' אמות שלה אפילו יכול הבעל לשמור כמוה מגורשת, וחוץ לד' אמות צריך שתוכל היא לשמרו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:7:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan says: She has four cubits - [This is] surprising, for later on [the Gemara] concludes [that this is] because it derives lost property from a get, thus the acquisition of four cubits is relevant to a get; yet in the chapter [entitled] HaZorek (Gittin 78b, and there s.v. R. Y.), Rabbi Yoḥanan says [that] "close to her" [means] even a hundred cubits, and [as long as] she is able to guard it, it is a [valid] get. And one can answer that within her four cubits, even if [the husband] is able to guard [it] like her, she is divorced, whereas outside of [her] four cubits, it is necessary that she be able to guard it:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:9:1.hebrew: ת"ל המצא תמצא מ"מ - וא"ת: ונימא "המצא תמצא" כלל, "בידו" פרט, וכלל ופרט אין בכלל אלא מה שבפרט? וי"ל: שדי "ידו" בין "המצא" "תמצא", וה"ל כלל ופרט וכלל, כדאמרינן במרובה (ב"ק דף סד: ושם): "כל מקום שאתה מוצא שני כללות הסמוכין זה לזה — הטל פרט ביניהם". וכן בסמוך גבי גט, דמרבה גגה מ"ונתן בידה", י"ל "ושלחה" חזר וכלל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10b:9:1.english: The verse states: "If [the theft] shall be found [himmatze timmatze]," in any case - And if you ask: Let us say [that] "himmatze timmatze" is a generalization, "in his hand [beyado]" is a specification, and [the rule for] a generalization and a specification [is that] the generalization includes only what is in the specification? One can answer: Place "his hand" between "himmatze" and "timmatze," and it becomes a generalization, a specification, and a generalization, as we say in [the chapter] Merubah (Bava Kamma 64b and there): "Wherever you find two generalizations that are adjacent to one another — place a specification between them." And similarly just below regarding a bill of divorce [get], where [the Gemara] includes her roof from "and he places [it] in her hand," one can say [that] "and he sends her away" returns and generalizes:
